entries.subject: DAMIT 13007: selected shape and spin
entries.finding: DAMIT model 13007, version 2022-11-29, pole (131°, -33°), period 28.484 h, taken unchanged from the archive.

entries.subject: Physical scale
entries.finding: 107.227 ± 0.494 km, effective diameter of a sphere fitted to thermal infrared measurements. JPL lists a diameter of 107.227 ± 0.494 km, from NEOWISE (Masiero et al. 2014, ApJ 791, 121; PDS bundle neowise_diameters_albedos 2.0). The thermal sphere diameter is transferred to the mesh as its volume-equivalent diameter.

entries.subject: Brixia whole-disc color
entries.finding: Gaia Collaboration, Galluccio et al. (2023) published the mean of 54 Gaia epoch spectra of the unresolved disc: reflectance against the Sun in 16 bands from 374 to 1034 nm, 1 at 550 nm (0.936 at 462 nm, 0.981 at 638 nm). The shape is painted in that one color (#4c4c49 in sRGB) through the shared disc-integrated-color method, scaled to the 7.3% geometric albedo JPL lists (± 1.4%), from NEOWISE (Masiero et al. 2014, ApJ 791, 121; PDS bundle neowise_diameters_albedos 2.0). It is one mean, not a map. Tinaut-Ruano et al. (2023), A&A 669, L14, found Gaia DR3 reflectances slightly too red at wavelengths shorter than 550 nm; the bands are used as published, without that paper's correction.
